Sam (CS): Hey team, we need a 1-page 'fastpath' runbook for customers: prefill vs on-demand, simple defaults, a tiny troubleshooting curl, and a 3-question feedback ping. Keep it short for kickoff emails.
Theo (Solutions): Make it copy-pasteable. One small YAML, one troubleshooting command, and a line on renewal signals.
Rae (Eng): I'll add recommended batch windows and a 2-line dev note about streaming CPU impact. Also call out KV key composition.
Sam (CS): Draft bullets: 1) Prefill when you have a small set of repeat prompts (TTL default: 3600s). 2) On-demand for exploratory/varied queries; use client debounce 100-200ms. 3) Server batch: 30-80ms favors latency, 80-200ms favors cost. 4) Streaming: enable for typing UX or responses >250 tokens; disable for micro calls.
Mira (PM): Renewal/health signals to flag: >35% drop in active sessions over 14d -> CSM touch; no smoke test in 7d -> SE ping; feedback response rate <10% at day7 -> schedule call.
Theo (Solutions): Pasteable YAML for customers:
```yaml
defaults:
  prefill_enabled: true
  prefill_ttl_s: 3600
  client_debounce_ms: 150
  server_batch_max_wait_ms: 50
  streaming_threshold_tokens: 250
```
Rae (Eng): Dev notes: - KV cache key: tenant|env|prompt_sha|ver. - Batch tradeoff: 30-80ms = low latency, 80-200ms = better cost. - Streaming keeps connections open and increases per-request CPU; best for interactive typing or >300 tokens. For <100-token hits prefer non-streaming.
Sam (CS): Feedback ping (day7) copy: "Quick 3: 1) Relevance 1-5 2) Latency OK? (y/n) 3) Anything blocking? (short)" Keep it <60s.
Theo (Solutions): Troubleshooting one-liner for bursty drops (metrics check):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/{tenant}/metrics?window=5m" | jq '.throughput, .latency_p95, .warm_pool_hit_rate'
```
Rae (Eng): Recovery tips (short): 1) Stale outputs after model change: increment KV ver and flush warm pool. 2) Warm-pool miss spike: increase server_batch_max_wait_ms to 120ms and temporarily enlarge warm pool. 3) If p95 latency >2x baseline: reduce batch window or move to dedicated capacity.
deploy-bot: deploy/finished cs-fastpath-runbook-v1 by theo at 2025-03-02T11:03:00Z :white_check_mark:
Sam (CS): Thanks — I'll add this to the kickoff email and attach the YAML + feedback ping. Anything else?
Rae (Eng): Maybe one sentence on cost: hosted customers, longer TTL reduces request count but may increase refresh costs; expect modest token savings when reuse is high.
Mira (PM): I'll link the renewal thresholds to the central renewal playbook. Sounds good to ship. :rocket:
